claims.statement: The AZIZ-selected model is the model consumed by 2D, 3D wall geometry and BOQ in the tested integration candidate.
limitations: Production runtime not independently verified.
Browser rendering correctness not proven.

claims.statement: The integrated Claude -> Gemini -> AZIZ path returns three validated RECT/L/U models and a SELECTED_PRELIMINARY decision for south, north, east and west entry tests.
limitations: This is test-path evidence, not production-runtime evidence.

claims.statement: Integrated project save/restore preserves the selected model and RECT/L/U alternatives exactly in the tested round-trip.
limitations: Historical and production persistence paths are not fully covered by this claim.

claims.statement: The tested dist/claude source files match vendor/claude-planner/src/ byte for byte.
limitations: Explicit per-file SHA values are not yet recorded in the registry.

claims.statement: A runtime Mizan Score implementation exists at dist/mizan-score.mjs and is invoked from dist/app.mjs.
limitations: No runtime trace has yet proven execution in a browser session.
Current implementation is a heuristic and does not yet satisfy the planned V1 specification.

claims.statement: README states that the current product supports only a rectangular mass and does not support L/U forms or courtyards.
limitations: Conflicts with newer automated-test evidence for the integrated candidate.

claims.statement: README states that saved designs are regenerated from their inputs and strategies during import.
limitations: Does not distinguish the later integrated embedded-model path.

claims.statement: home-design-engine exposes a separate evaluation.score and compareHomeModels() computes a bestId from the highest evaluation score.
limitations: No evidence yet that bestId replaces the AZIZ-selected model in live execution.

claims.statement: In the inspected app orchestration path, state.model is assigned from runMultiEngineDesign().selectedModel, while compareHomeModels() is computed separately for engineering evaluation display.
limitations: No browser runtime trace.

claims.statement: The current system-map boundary for aziz-engine declares that AZIZ must not own score-definition.
limitations: Governance/system-map declaration only.

claims.statement: The inspected AZIZ implementation contains a scoring engine that defines weighted axes, computes confidenceAdjustedTotal, ranks candidates, and uses that ranking to select selectedCandidateId.
limitations: No independent production runtime trace.

claims.statement: Two distinct Gemini review paths are present in inspected code: an integrated bound reviewCandidate() gate before AZIZ selection and a UI analyzeGeminiEngineering(state.model) review path.
limitations: Coexistence does not by itself prove an execution conflict.

claims.statement: Planner runtime code is present and used, but the current components registry contains PlannerOutputContract rather than a standalone canonical Planner engine component.
limitations: Canonical planner ownership boundary remains unresolved.

claims.statement: The inspected Engineering Core copy used by the UI Gemini bridge is not byte-identical to the Engineering Core copy used by the integrated review pipeline.
limitations: This proves divergence of the inspected copies only.
It does not establish which copy is canonical or newer.

claims.statement: Candidate identity is derived from request/input/geometry/producer data, geometryHash is derived from canonical geometry, and selectedModel carries candidateId and geometryHash from the selected candidate.
claims.scope: Identity creation, selected-model mapping, and exact persistence test scope
limitations: Downstream 2D/3D/BOQ outputs do not themselves carry independently verified output hashes.

claims.statement: home-design comparison uses a plan-local bestId rather than the canonical candidateId, while retaining the original model in sourceModel.
limitations: Does not prove a lineage break or canonical identity replacement.

claims.statement: The UI Gemini engineering review path uses locally derived deterministic fingerprints and does not expose the selected model candidateId/geometryHash binding that exists in the integrated review path.
claims.scope: Static comparison of the two Gemini review paths
limitations: Potential lineage issue only; no LINEAGE_BREAK classification is made.

claims.statement: After a manual opening edit on an integrated model, the geometry changes while the copied integration.geometryHash and integration.candidateId are not recomputed before the edited model becomes state.model.
claims.scope: Manual opening edit path in dist/planner.mjs and dist/app.mjs
limitations: Static code evidence; no new executable identity assertion was run in this audit turn.

claims.statement: bestId is a local comparison identifier and is not referenced by the inspected app.mjs as a replacement for state.model or canonical candidateId.
claims.scope: Static inspection of home-design-engine.mjs and app.mjs
limitations: Absence of use is limited to the inspected current app path.

claims.statement: The UI Gemini review is recomputed from the current state.model on each inspected displayed model replacement path, but the review result still lacks direct canonical candidateId/geometryHash binding.
claims.scope: Static inspection of current UI review flow
limitations: This supports continuity of displayed review freshness, not canonical provenance.

claims.statement: Integrated project persistence preserves embedded model identity metadata exactly; therefore stale candidateId/geometryHash metadata introduced by a manual edit would persist across save/restore.
claims.scope: Manual edit plus integrated project persistence path
limitations: Static composition of two observed code paths; no new end-to-end runtime test was executed.
